recon.notes: Year determination: the hero says "BeefDip Bear Week 2026" / "Jan 23 – 31" but the accordion headers say 2027 and the items say "Saturday, Jan 23", "Sun Jan 24" … "Sun Jan 31"; `cal` confirms Jan 23 2027 is a Saturday (Jan 23 2026 was a Friday) and Jan 31 2027 is a Sunday (Jan 31 2029, the last header's typo, is a Wednesday). Every event is therefore 2027 with high confidence from weekday arithmetic; homepage and tags page independently say 2027. Timezone: Puerto Vallarta is in Jalisco → America/Mexico_City (Nuevo Vallarta across the bay is America/Bahia_Banderas); both are fixed UTC-6 since Mexico abolished DST in 2022, so wall-clock is identical, and scraper-cities "pv" uses America/Mexico_City. The run of 2026-09-09 (20260909-072307) produced 45 events, 16 removed as duplicates, 29 kept: 16 dated 2026 (from the 2026 flyers), 6 non-events from the /tags/ page (welcome-center hours, pass products, Pride 2026), and titles rewritten from flyers ("Welcome T-Dance", "THE BLOCK BALL", "Carnival Mardi Gras"). No page-cache entry exists for /planned-events/ (cache holds /, /charity/, /discounts/, /gallery-*; fetchedAt 2026-08-27 and 2026-09-07).

traps.label: Hero: "BeefDip Bear Week 2026" / "Jan 23 – 31 • Puerto Vallarta"
traps.why: The page hero still says 2026 while the programme below it is the 2027 edition (day headers say 2027; Jan 23 is a Saturday only in 2027). A scraper that takes the year from the hero dates every event a year early. The homepage ("BeefDip Bear Week 2027 / JANUARY 24 - 31") and the tags page ("January 24 – 31, 2027") corroborate 2027.
traps.note: The run has 16 of its 29 surviving events dated January/February 2026.

traps.label: Accordion header "SUNDAY JANUARY 31, 2029"
traps.why: Site typo: Jan 31 2029 is a Wednesday, and the three items under it all say "Sun Jan 31". The header is one accordion title, not an event, and its year must not be trusted; the items belong to 2027-01-31.

traps.label: EVENT HIGHLIGHTS cards (WELCOME PARTY, BOOZE CRUISE, WHITE PARTY, THE BLACK BALL) with "See Full Schedule"

traps.label: Every event flyer is last year's artwork with 2026 dates (e.g. "SUNDAY JANUARY 25 · 3 PM – 12 AM")
traps.why: The 22 dated flyers (filenames 2026-01-25 … 2026-02-01) are the 2026-edition posters: each prints a weekday+date one day later than the 2027 page text and a 2026-only weekday match (Jan 25 2026 was a Sunday). OCR that trusts the flyer over the page text dates the event in 2026, and OCR that trusts the flyer title renames it ("WELCOME T-DANCE", "Carnival Mardi Gras", "HYDRATE"). Flyer venue lines also carry addresses the page does not (Delfin "CALLE RODOLFO GOMEZ 111, PV").
traps.note: Run rows dated 2026: "Welcome T-Dance" 2026-01-25, "Foam Pool Party" 2026-01-26, "TIDAL WAVE" 2026-01-29, "Booze Cruise" 2026-01-30, "HYDRATE" 2026-02-01, "SWEAT" 2026-02-02 and more.

openQuestions.q: Should the scraper take the year from the accordion day headers (2027) or the hero (2026)? The site will keep the stale hero until someone edits it; day-header weekday+date agreement is the only reliable signal on this page.
